name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native selective routing: declare solo, delegate, audit, or exceptional full delivery before work begins.

interface.shortDescription: Declare a risk-gated route and use at most one auxiliary by default.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps architecture, verification, and acceptance with the root. Before work begins, it declares a SELECTIVE ROUTE: solo is the default; delegate uses Luna / Max for bounded work or Terra / High for higher-risk work; audit uses a fresh read-only Reviewer; full combines one implementer with a fresh review only for a broad or high-risk exception. Spawned auxiliary evidence is fail-closed.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Use solo by default; select delegate, audit, or exceptional full only when the stated risk justifies it.
